notes: Finna search-API response (per manifest, lookfor=topic_id_str_mv:"melinda.(FI-ASTERI-N)000061572", National Library of Finland) listing 33 bibliographic records that have Twain as SUBJECT (e.g. 'The life of Mark Twain' 2022, 'Huck Finn among the critics' 1984, 'Mark Twain, Dr. Oliver Wendell Holmes, and the head readers' 2023, theatre review '[Teatteriarvostelu:Huckleberry Finn]'). Records carry only shortTitle/formats/id/year, no person-level data and no authorship, so nothing is extracted; some hits are Twain texts (e.g. 'The war prayer', 'Omaelämäkertani') but the response does not attribute them to him. The 33 search hits are works with him as subject; they were added as subject_of outside the model pass.
